event.summary: Removed per-session old-terminal resolver is superseded at startup
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: Considered whether removing the per-session warning resolver leaves obsolete old-terminal warnings unresolved after Restart; source shows the global startup resolver supersedes it. Details: The assigned patch removes the previous store.rs:5784 resolve_session_notifications_of_kind. Its only parent-revision caller is service/notifications.rs:505-545, the removed tmux sampling reconciliation; there are no current callers (git grep at reviewed revision). Current store.rs:5773-5795 resolves all unresolved notifications matching exactly the supplied kind, across sessions and generations. service/core/old_terminals.rs:525-547 always calls it with OldTerminal after recording OldTerminalEnded; service/core.rs:7080-7090 calls record_ended even when the converted list is empty, before session publication. SPEC.md:2804-2814 explicitly says: 'no warning is recorded any more, and every supervisor start marks any unresolved one resolved' and 'Nothing resolves the notice: it stays unresolved'. SPEC_impl.md:5842-5848 explicitly requires the global update and distinguishes old_terminal from old_terminal_ended. The remaining resolver matches the former kind only, preserving the latter notices. Suggested bucket: other if it were a bug; no established impact. Confidence: confirmed by source and contract, no execution. proposed_drop: removal is safe because the only former use is retired and the required global replacement is invoked at startup. could_be_highest: false; notification resolution alone has no demonstrated security or loss-of-work route. possible_cover: none. Caveats: failures are logged and startup continues per contract; no runtime behavior was observed.

event.summary: Removed per-session old-terminal resolver is superseded at startup
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: Considered whether removing per-session warning resolution leaves obsolete warnings unresolved or accidentally resolves newer terminal-ended notices and unrelated problems. Source shows the replacement has an exact old-warning key and separate notice lifetime. Details: The assigned patch removes former store.rs:5784 resolve_session_notifications_of_kind; its sole parent-revision caller, service/notifications.rs:505-545, was the retired tmux sampling reconciliation, and no caller remains at the reviewed revision. Current store.rs:5773-5795 uses WHERE kind = ?1 AND resolved_at IS NULL, across sessions and generations. Its sole production caller is service/core/old_terminals.rs:542-546 and supplies NotificationKind::OldTerminal.as_str(). service/notifications.rs:151-164 exhaustively gives the nine current kinds distinct strings: old_terminal is the old warning, old_terminal_ended is the new notice, and no unrelated kind shares old_terminal. service/notifications.rs:117-129 also excludes both old-terminal kinds from Resume resolution. core.rs:7080-7090 invokes record_ended even with an empty converted-session list, before session publication. SPEC.md:2804-2814 says: 'no warning is recorded any more, and every supervisor start marks any unresolved one resolved' and 'Nothing resolves the notice: it stays unresolved'. SPEC_impl.md:5842-5848 explicitly requires the global old_terminal update and distinct old_terminal_ended key. Suggested bucket: other if this concern were established; no demonstrated wrong behavior. Confidence: confirmed through source and contract, no execution. proposed_drop: the removed resolver's only use is retired, its replacement is invoked at startup, and exact key equality preserves the new notice and unrelated current kinds. could_be_highest: false; notification resolution has no established security or loss-of-work route. possible_cover: parent reports independent g129/c3 source confirmation of the distinct key and resolves_on_resume=false; no coverage sources were searched. Caveats: database write failures are logged and startup continues by contract; later-turn synthesis is checking caller/failure details further. Original considered consequence, obsolete warnings surviving or new notices being erased, is preserved here. Revision reason: independently checked all current notification keys and Resume policy to settle the cross-group interaction.

event.summary: Terminal-host exit-code wording matches the host adapter
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: Considered whether replacing tmux exit-status documentation incorrectly describes signal deaths after the terminal-host switch. Details: The changed LastOutcome::Exited documentation at store.rs:190-193 says a missing exit code covers a signal death. Source check of hosts/terminal.rs:854-889 confirms the public exit-code contract and conversion: ChildExit::Code(code) becomes Some(code), ChildExit::Signal(_) becomes None. Therefore the changed comment matches the actual adapter and does not misdescribe a synthesized 128-plus-signal exit code. Suggested bucket: other; no user-visible incorrect behavior established. Confidence: confirmed by source; no runtime execution. proposed_drop: source refutes the suspected documentation mismatch. could_be_highest: false; this candidate concerns explanatory wording only, without a security or loss-of-work route. possible_cover: none. Caveats: this is a check of the assigned documentation change, not an independent audit of terminal-host process exit handling.

event.summary: Pre-host hook/provenance comments match the launch preparation boundary
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: Considered whether the rewritten storage documentation promises hook/provenance recording before a terminal-host start while the new host path can actually start first, allowing an early conversation report to outrun its metadata. Source refutes that ordering mismatch. Details: Assigned store.rs:1443 and :1484 plus :5610-5623 replace pre-tmux wording with pre-host wording. service/core/host_launch.rs:451-473 awaits prepare_launch and returns on its failure before start_host at :537. prepare_launch in core.rs:14570-14585 awaits launch provenance and the hook-policy store call before returning PreparedLaunch at :14591-14600. record_launch_provenance at core.rs:7496-7503 awaits OMP recording, and core/vendor/omp.rs:44-56 awaits the provenance store call. Consequently the launch boundary described in these changed comments is real: the host start cannot precede completion of those attempted writes. Recording is best effort: a database failure logs and permits the launch without capture/diagnostics (core.rs:14554-14588 and vendor/omp.rs:46-56); the comments establish ordering, not guaranteed successful persistence despite a failed database call. Suggested bucket: other if a documentation mismatch were present; no incorrect production behavior or lost conversation established. event.summary: Outcome-backfill comment promises live reconciliation that legacy rows no longer receive
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: The migration explanation tells maintainers that old sessions get checked against their live terminals, but this release deliberately skips that check and classifies the old rows through terminal retirement. This is inaccurate migration documentation, with no demonstrated runtime defect. Details: The assigned rewrite at store.rs:1832-1834 says: 'the very first reload after this migration reconciles each row against its live terminal anyway.' This is the version-1 outcome backfill (1824-1853), where every existing row gets outcome_state=launching. The same ordered migration ladder later adds terminal_kind with DEFAULT tmux at :2493-2508, so those rows are old-kind rows, not host rows eligible for live adoption. Current reload at service/core.rs:6675-6679 unconditionally maps Tmux to None and explicitly never looks up its address; :6805-6822 sends no-sentinel live-outcome old rows through Transition::TerminalEnded and continues before the ordinary terminal-evidence reconciliation. Thus the asserted live-terminal reconciliation is not the reason those legacy outcomes can be safely defaulted in this release. SPEC_impl.md:2903-2909 accurately says the reload takes every old-kind row as having no terminal, without looking its recorded pane id up, and converts still-live outcomes unless the sentinel establishes Error. Production behavior satisfies that intended retirement contract; that does not make this distinct explanatory promise accurate. Fix direction: retain the conservative historical launching default while explaining that current reload applies old-terminal retirement, rather than claiming a live probe is still performed. Range check: the base revision 6e423e30068b62c6cfa276c6d720ee35bb70387a:store.rs:1795-1797 had the historical live-tmux-probe explanation. The assigned commit expressly rewrites that line to the current live-terminal claim. The complete store.rs history within the pinned range was inspected, and the full diff from the reviewed revision to tip 00de0b6c9cf206f1a7c9c5ad1c76b5b10eaf85db changes only two unrelated comments, so this statement is not later repaired. The earlier in-range retirement commit dbfc69751215dbf15e1d31d5bed73c3754c4ebc4 already supplies the runtime change; direct attribution checks follow before delivery. Suggested bucket: other (internal documentation correctness). Confidence: confirmed source/contract mismatch, no execution. proposed_drop: false; retirement acceptance describes intended behavior, not acceptance of a misleading migration explanation. could_be_highest: false; no security or user-work-loss route asserted from this comment. possible_cover: no matching record in supplied neighbour findings; prohibited coverage sources not searched. Caveats: the schema/backfill code itself is unchanged by the assigned patch, and no change to the migration default or retirement policy is requested. This revision closes l1's migration-kind premise and retains the original consequence of a misleading migration invariant/rationale.
